title: Scheduling in Queueing Systems with Uncertain and Evolving Holding Costs
abstract: arXiv:2505.21331v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In queueing systems, the holding costs of jobs may evolve in uncertain ways. For example, in content moderation for social media platforms, the cost of delaying the review of a content piece is proportional to its view trajectory, which fluctuates and is a priori unknown. To capture such uncertain and evolving holding cost patterns, we consider a queueing model where job states evolve based on a Markov chain with state-dependent instantaneous holding costs. We demonstrate that in the presence of such uncertain and evolving holding costs, the two canonical algorithmic principles, instantaneous-cost ($c\mu$-rule) and expected-remaining-cost ($c\mu/\theta$-rule), are suboptimal. By viewing each job as a Markovian ski-rental problem, we develop a new index-based algorithm, Opportunity-adjusted Remaining Cost (OaRC), that adjusts to the opportunity of serving jobs in the future when uncertainty partly resolves. translated_title: 具有不确定且动态演变持有成本的排队系统调度问题
translated_abstract: 在排队系统中，作业的持有成本可能以不确定的方式演变。例如，在社交媒体平台的内容审核场景中，延迟审核某条内容的成本与其浏览轨迹成正比，而浏览轨迹是波动的且先验未知的。为了刻画这种不确定且动态演变的持有成本模式，我们考虑了一个排队模型，其中作业状态基于马尔可夫链演变，并具有依赖于状态的瞬时持有成本。我们证明，在这种不确定且动态演变的持有成本存在的情况下，两种经典的算法准则——瞬时成本（cμ规则）和期望剩余成本（cμ/θ规则）——都是次优的。通过将每个作业视为一个马尔可夫滑雪租赁问题，我们开发了一种新的基于指标的算法——机会调整剩余成本算法，该算法能够在不确定性部分消解时，根据未来服务作业的机会进行调整。我们证明了次优……
tldr: 针对持有成本不确定且动态演变的排队系统，论文证明经典cμ规则与cμ/θ规则均次优，并提出基于马尔可夫滑雪租赁问题视角的新指标算法OaRC，可在不确定性部分消解时自适应调整调度决策。
en_tdlr: For queueing systems with uncertain and evolving holding costs, this paper shows that the classical cμ-rule and cμ/θ-rule are suboptimal, and proposes a new index-based algorithm, Opportunity-adjusted Remaining Cost (OaRC), which adapts to future service opportunities as uncertainty partially resolves.
